name: What are the differences between standing seam and metal shingle roofs?

mainEntity.name: What are the differences between standing seam and metal shingle roofs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standing seam metal roofs feature raised seams that lock panels together, providing superior weather protection and a sleek, modern look. Metal shingles mimic the appearance of traditional asphalt or wood shakes but offer the durability of metal. A practical tradeoff is appearance versus traditional aesthetics; standing seam offers excellent longevity and leak resistance, while metal shingles provide a familiar look with metal's benefits. Your choice depends on aesthetic preference and budget.
